expected_observable_behavior.zh: 第2–5天转矩值滞后时间戳0.5s，转矩-速度关系变散。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Days 2–5: torque values lag their timestamps by 0.5 s, smearing the torque–speed relationship.

expected_health_response.zh: 检测到未对齐（MISALIGNED）；转矩残差分析弃权；不得误报 WARNING。
expected_health_response.en: Misalignment detected (MISALIGNED); torque-residual analysis abstains; no false WARNING.

abstention_cases.zh: 对齐不可靠时转矩残差必须弃权（DATA_QUALITY）。
abstention_cases.en: Torque residuals must abstain when alignment is unreliable (DATA_QUALITY).
